decision: Preserve the actual informed original-owner callbacks as useful fix rechecks, including their discovered issues. New current-page backfill collection uses new fresh reader tasks for entries/loop/products with independent gated sessions; validation retains its genuinely new current task and its informed revision callback. The existing incremental policy assigns each task to exactly one review wave, so old reader owners are not relabeled or moved into a later fresh wave. New current readers provide their own observations, not another task signature on the callbacks.
original_owner_callback_role: Independent preservation of prior fixes and exact issue rechecks, not a new blind first reading.
